import { rankSourceItems } from "../../../domain";
import type { FetchedSourceItem } from "../../../ports";
import type { AdaptivePaginationPolicy } from "../adaptive-source-pagination";
import type { readSourceItemRankingPlan } from "../source-item-ranking-config";
import type { XExperimentalDailyScanConfig } from "./x-twitter-experimental-daily-config";
import {
  compareXCollectedPosts, normalizeXPost, xPostMatchesMetricThresholds,
  xPostMatchesSearchQuery, xPostSignalScore, type XCanonicalRankingPost,
} from "./x-twitter-experimental-daily-item";

export type XCanonicalCandidate<P extends XCanonicalRankingPost> = {
  readonly post: P;
  readonly searchQuery: string;
  readonly maxItems: number;
};

// Budgets constrain collector requests and describe normalization; they do not
// truncate returned posts. Collector scoring/capping has already happened.
export const resolveXQueryBudget = (
  config: XExperimentalDailyScanConfig, searchQuery: string,
): number => config.maxItemsBySearchQuery.get(searchQuery) ?? config.maxItemsPerQuery;

export const resolveXQueryTarget = (
  queryMaxItems: number, queryCount: number,
  paginationPolicy: AdaptivePaginationPolicy | undefined,
): number => paginationPolicy === undefined ? queryMaxItems : Math.max(
  queryMaxItems, Math.ceil(paginationPolicy.targetItems / Math.max(queryCount, 1)),
);

/** Call for each returned page in canonical order, BEFORE filtering the lane. */
export function reduceXReturnedPage<P extends XCanonicalRankingPost>(
  postsByTweetId: Map<string, P>, posts: readonly P[],
): { pageNewItemCount: number; pageDuplicateCount: number } {
  let pageNewItemCount = 0;
  let pageDuplicateCount = 0;
  for (const post of posts) {
    const existing = postsByTweetId.get(post.tweetId);
    if (existing === undefined) {
      postsByTweetId.set(post.tweetId, post);
      pageNewItemCount += 1;
      continue;
    }
    pageDuplicateCount += 1;
    if (xPostSignalScore(post) > xPostSignalScore(existing)) {
      postsByTweetId.set(post.tweetId, post);
    }
  }
  return { pageNewItemCount, pageDuplicateCount };
}

/** Input is a reduced complete lane, never raw acquisition occurrences. */
export function mergeXCanonicalLane<P extends XCanonicalRankingPost>(
  postsByExternalId: Map<string, XCanonicalCandidate<P>>, posts: readonly P[],
  searchQuery: string, maxItems: number, config: XExperimentalDailyScanConfig,
): void {
  for (const post of posts.filter((item) =>
    xPostMatchesMetricThresholds(item.metrics, config) &&
    (!config.requireQueryMatch || xPostMatchesSearchQuery(item, searchQuery, maxItems)),
  )) {
    const externalId = `x-twitter:${post.tweetId}`;
    const existing = postsByExternalId.get(externalId);
    if (existing === undefined || xPostSignalScore(post) > xPostSignalScore(existing.post)) {
      postsByExternalId.set(externalId, { post, searchQuery, maxItems });
    }
  }
}

/** Stable signal/publication order precedes the existing ranking policy. */
export function rankXCanonicalSelection<P extends XCanonicalRankingPost>(
  postsByExternalId: ReadonlyMap<string, XCanonicalCandidate<P>>,
  rankingPlan: ReturnType<typeof readSourceItemRankingPlan>, planMaxItems: number,
  paginationPolicy: AdaptivePaginationPolicy | undefined,
  normalize: (item: XCanonicalCandidate<P>) => FetchedSourceItem =
    (item) => normalizeXPost(item.post, item.searchQuery, item.maxItems),
): readonly FetchedSourceItem[] {
  const normalizedItems = [...postsByExternalId.values()]
    .sort((left, right) => compareXCollectedPosts(left.post, right.post))
    .map(normalize);
  const outputItemLimit = Math.max(planMaxItems, paginationPolicy?.targetItems ?? 0);
  return rankSourceItems(normalizedItems, rankingPlan).slice(0, outputItemLimit);
}
